description: An assignment targets `@proj`, the auto-declared variable of a `derived=` machine. Per §51.9 a projected variable is read-only and the write is rejected with E-ENGINE-017 (§34: Error).
rationale: §51.9 — a derived variable is a PROJECTION of its source: its value is a pure function of the source machine's current variant, recomputed on every source change. A write to it would be clobbered by the next projection, so the write is rejected rather than silently lost. This is the machine-surface twin of L21 (E-DERIVED-VALUE-MUTATE) for derived reactive cells — a derived value is read-only from the author's side.
